items.summary: Authorize no new discretionary spend, monetization expansion, queue expansion, requeues, or external outreach. AI spend is $963.569 for 2026-09-01 through 2026-09-26 across 5,390 calls, with 232 errors and 5 transient errors. Revenue evidence covers only 2026-09-21: 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 aggregate commission; site-attributed commission is $0 because the income is unassignable. Contribution margin, ROI, and revenue forecasts are unsupported. Cost-to-learn is not calculable because experiment-level costs and incremental attributable outcomes are unavailable. Infrastructure, domain, labor, marketing, and other operating costs are unknown and must not be inferred from AI spend. Budget exposure is unbounded because monthly spend limit, fixed costs, marketing budget, revenue floor, and attribution materiality threshold are blank. Continue only existing measurement, reconciliation, failure-containment, security-evidence, and private-launch workstreams. Minimum finance measurement is a period-aligned site/fleet cost ledger matched to attributable commission, plus experiment-level cost and incremental attributable outcomes.
